# Positive composition inputs

These literal positive cases belong to the standalone vocabulary composition
catalogue test boundary. They are not proof of compiler/project/codec activation.
See the parent fixture README for ownership and the pinned conformance manifest.

`requests.json` adds frozen projects with both variant origins, imported variants,
heterogeneous lists/defaults/absence, an exact diamond lock closure and composed
list/nullable/reference types. Catalogue outcomes execute now; compiler outcomes
remain requirements for later activation.
